tid_unit_1001_description: Like a phoenix — the symbol of rebirth — this dragon is said to be immortal. His fiery feathers and regal flight are an impressive sight. It is said that this bird's cry is that of a beautiful song.

tid_unit_1019_description: Is it getting hot on your island? The Ice Cube Dragon is just the creature to cool things down. Calm, cool as ice, and quite slow. This friendly fellow poses no threat at all.

tid_unit_1048_description: Precious by nature, this dragon is the most giving of them all. If you take good care of him and feed him well, he might just lay a beautiful golden egg.

tid_unit_1006_description: This undead dragon has a huge appetite! He keeps eating, but somehow nothing seems to fill him up. Despite his constant hunger, forgetful nature, and bad vision, he has proven to be loyal.

tid_unit_1181_description: In the darkest nights, the Nightwind Dragon howls to the sky like a wolf. Your heart will freeze if you hear him!

tid_unit_1191_description: Full of rage and anger, Kratus is the last of his kind. He is known as the Dragon of War. Feared, respected, and also admired by all, no one dares to face him in battle.

tid_unit_1119_description: Despite his size, Dujur is as light as a spring cloud and therefore needs no wings to fly. Dujur brings good luck with him wherever he goes and never gets tired of helping children!

tid_unit_1318_description: The Core Dragon is one of the Space Dragons. He is in charge of creating new planets. As a Dragon Master, you'd be pleased to have him in your city.

tid_unit_1092_description: Comfortable both below and above water, this dragon is known as the “wanderer” because she can travel thousands of miles without rest. With her magnificent glow, she's especially impressive at night.

tid_unit_1647_description: 48 football fields worth of forest are lost to deforestation every minute. The Forest Lord Dragon is helping protect the Earth from that destruction. Will you help him save his home?

tid_unit_1098_description: The prettier counterpart of the power couple — Their Majesties King and Queen Dragon — is known for her peaceful and fair nature. Only the tricks of the evil witch will awaken her dark fury!

tid_unit_1115_description: This dragon is the boss of all the pirates and can use her evil tentacles to fight up to 8 opponents at the same time! Beat her and you can be very proud of your achievement.

tid_unit_1131_description: Time to laugh! This very rare dragon loves pranks and tricks. If you give him the chance, you'll find a sticker on your back saying “Kick Me!”

tid_unit_1150_description: Jewels, gold, magic crystals, diamonds… The Treasure Dragon hoards the riches of his defeated enemies in his lair. Only a Dragon Master can tame the Treasure Dragon. Is that you?

tid_unit_1178_description: Ukma akma atmu utma, entu entu aku aku!!! This is actually the war cry of the Tribal Dragon and means "attack"!

tid_unit_1202_description: A real trickster! The Hypno Dragon can make you believe you're a chicken or a frog! By spinning his spiral eyes, he hypnotizes everyone who tries to resist his will. It’s better to be his friend, but wait... He has no friends! You'd better run!

tid_unit_1222_description: Want to hear something that sets your teeth on edge? Then come close to the Big Claws Dragon’s habitat when he is filing his claws. Asking him to stop won’t help at all, though. It’s the way he trains for battle.

tid_unit_1266_description: This dragon likes to live in the rainforest. He can camouflage himself to blend in with nature. The Manglar Dragon is as peaceful and strong as an ox!

tid_unit_1290_description: The Sensei Dragon is surrounded by a mystical aura, and you can feel his magical presence whenever you are near him. He is so powerful that he was born with his adult stage (lvl 10)!

tid_unit_1320_description: From the Social Point Fan Art contest comes the Dolphin Dragon! It's said that these animals are social, but this particular one prefers a "Like" to a sardine!

tid_unit_1336_description: This horrifying Kaiju Dragon was first seen in 1954. It is said that he was born from atomic explosions, but he loves tomatoes, too. Some people know him as the King of the Monsters!

tid_unit_1362_description: The Crowned Dragon is soccer royalty and one of the best players of Dragon City. This beloved dragon is admired and respected by all because he’d rather lose than leave another dragon behind. His love for teamwork is what makes him so great!

tid_unit_1377_description: Happy Independence Day! This dragon was born on the 4th of July, 1776, and helped the Americans in their fight for independence with his courage and determination. He is the most patriotic dragon in Dragon City.

tid_unit_1392_description: This awesome dragon doesn't care what came first: the dragon or the egg. It really doesn't matter to him because he needed both to be born!

tid_unit_1407_description: Golem arrives in Dragon City alone, disoriented, and overwhelmed. Sensing the fears and desires of those around him, he must keep himself from being drawn in, or he risks revealing his nature.

tid_unit_1423_description: The Mistletoe Dragon has only been to the city once. The fact that all the lovers kissed as he walked past made him pretty sad! He went back to the woods, feeling lonely, and now he only comes out for battle.

tid_unit_1443_description:
This dragon can only be obtained through breeding in the Ancient World!
This affable creature enjoys being around children. They love to pop him and see how he puts himself together again. He also smells really good.

tid_unit_1458_description: The Atlantean Dragon is the proud guard of the Heart of Atlantis, a stone that contains all the secrets of Atlantis Island. While he's on duty, no one shall take the stone.

tid_unit_1477_description: Hope is the dream of the soul awake. Hope is the last thing you lose. Bring hope into your life and the Hope Dragon into your island!

tid_unit_1494_description: The same way baby dragons look for animals in the clouds when they look at the sky, adults like to find shapes in the Rorschach Dragon. What each of them sees says a lot about their personality.

tid_unit_1513_description: If your mom always tells you not to play with the bad boys, stay away from this dragon. However, if you’re looking for trouble, he will gladly become your partner in crime.

tid_unit_1529_description: Oh, say! Can you see by the dawn’s early light how this dragon can fly like he’s sailing the skies?

tid_unit_1547_description: Wood is supposed to burn to ashes when it’s on fire so… why doesn’t this wooden dragon burn to the ground? It’s magic!

tid_unit_1566_description: Does this dragon look familiar to you? You might spot a similar creature roaming your Islands, but you should know that the White Alien Dragon is, in fact, an imposter. His obsession with a mystic tribe has brought him here...

tid_unit_1613_description: This dragon is used to being the king wherever he goes. He doesn’t like anyone getting in his way or trying to outdo him. He will stop anyone from catching up to him, by fair means or foul

tid_unit_1628_description: This creature is like the personal guard to the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse: he ensures that Conquest, War, Famine, and Death are spread across the world. Owning him assures victory, even against the Horsemen.

tid_unit_1655_description: The Diva Dragon is known for her diva-ish ways and her ever-changing look. She’s particular and likes things to be just right. If her tomatoes aren’t firm enough or her habitat isn’t at the right temperature, she’ll be the first to complain.

tid_unit_1674_description: What sound do you hear when dragons eat spicy salsa? The fire alarm!

tid_unit_1730_description: The Crazy Dragon might be mysterious, but he’s real serious. He’s also imperious and will leave you real curious. His name is the Crazy Dragon… won’t you like his videos?

tid_unit_1735_description: Ready for a ride? Hop on the Terrifying Dragon, but only if you aren't afraid of fire, intense speed, and the high probability of being devoured by one of his heads.

tid_unit_1752_description: The Royal Phoenix Dragon has loyally served generations of kings as a messenger and bearer of secrets. Some say that he has so much information about wars and kingdoms that he’s more powerful than any of the kings he’s assisted.

tid_unit_1793_description: This dragon may need to wear a helmet, but he's no space cadet when it comes to winning battles! He keeps an eye on his opponent's every move, waiting for the right moment to strike.

tid_unit_1789_description: Half T-rex and half dragon, the Silly Dragon is much stronger than he looks. Underneath the funny faces and corny one-liners, there's a lean, mean fighting machine. Try him out and you'll have a roaring good time!

tid_unit_1810_description: A Norwegian smith sculpted him out of a big steel block while Magni, the Norse god of strength, also son of Thor, guided his gouge. That kind of makes this dragon Thor’s grandson! Isn’t that cool? He is respected by the whole community.

tid_unit_1817_description: One of the most dangerous dragons, the Blade Dragon is ruthless and cutthroat when he strikes, although his giant blades can make his movements seem clumsy. He loves honing its fighting skills by mowing down his enemies.

tid_unit_1899_description: Meeting this hooded dragon can send chills down your spine. The Skull Dragon is an eerie creature haunting the battlefield with the awful clanking and screeching sounds of his chains. Not many can withstand the madness of his stare and his otherworldly powers.

tid_unit_1884_description: The Bjorn Dragon was brought into the Terra Arena as a young cub and has since made it his home. He has eschewed the bells and whistles of other arenas, keeping it austere and akin to his rugged nature. Nothing more appropriate as the scene of the brutal combats held in it.

tid_unit_1834_description: The Vigilante Dragon has made it his mission to fight crime and injustice, usually after dark. To do so, he relies not only on his superior intelligence, but also on keeping in peak physical condition and training vigorously. He is a brooding character who does not suffer fools lightly.

tid_unit_1836_description:
Heroic Dragons evolve to their young stage at level 10 and become adults at level 20.

The High Snow Dragon comes down from the tallest mountains. He is a crepuscular creature, so he is at his best at dawn and at dusk. His super physique makes him a deadly opponent.

tid_unit_2041_description: When the Burglar Dragon, also known as Kenny, was little he was quite lonely. However, when he learned to use his ghost hands, everyone was fascinated by his abilities. The problem is that he ended up using his hands to steal and draw the attention of his friends… He became a burglar!

tid_unit_1873_description: The Anemone Dragon may be rough and tough on the outside, but he’s a big softy on the inside. He likes to appear that way because if he laughs too hard it will trigger his poisonous tentacles and nobody wants that, now do they? Just ask the many friends he’s stung by accident.

tid_unit_1939_description: The Piston Dragon was auto racing’s secret formula...until it escaped. Designed with resiliency and an explosive burn, this dragon couldn’t bear being confined to life on the race tracks so it used its innovation to flee to Dragon City.

tid_unit_2032_description: They may look innocent but be careful what you say around these dragons—they love to gossip. They’re always stirring up drama and can be seen running from habitat to habitat or lying flat on the ground eavesdropping to get some juicy dirt.

tid_unit_2052_description: There are rumors floating around that this dragon’s bark is worse than his bite, but let us be very clear...one sting from this dragon and you will need to seek immediate medical attention. So yes, he’s as aggressive as he looks.

tid_unit_1952_description: This dragon wants to put his big boy pants on but he’s not the bravest. He spends most of his time hiding in the corner and needs a serious pep-talk before doing just about anything. But when he has courage, he’s unstoppable.

tid_unit_1968_description: The Neo-Izumi Dragon is a pro with her sword. Her attacks are as incredible as she is and her skill is so good, she could attack with her eyes closed. Facts: the reason the Neo-Kira Dragon stays out of trouble is because she’s got his back.

tid_unit_2011_description: Enemies of the Ternion Dragon never last long because this warrior is a well-oiled machine and has programmed himself to destroy all those against him. He never misses a beat and will ruthlessly go far and wide to ensure that the job is done.

tid_unit_1993_description: No one really knows if the Psychic Dragon actually has psychic abilities. He’s always trying to mind read, predict the future, and promises he can see things with his third eye. Odd thing is: he only sees himself winning all the battles.

tid_unit_1845_description: The Coyote Dragon is never up to any good. He’s a sly troublemaker who goes around looking for things to get into. This creature loves to cause a commotion and then frame others to take the fall. Avoid him, or you may end up in hot water.

tid_unit_1745_description:
Heroic Dragons evolve to their young stage at level 10 and become adults at level 20.

As the God of nature, this majestic creature is so powerful that vegetation grows wherever he steps and he can make any plant grow at will. With the Fae Dragons under his wing, he will stop at nothing to protect the beloved forests.

tid_unit_2039_description: The Drummer Dragon is driven by rage and sees nothing but evil. When this creature prepares to attack, he creates a charge in his body that fuels him through battle. He’s always on target and his horns will pierce the toughest materials.

tid_unit_2065_description: The Pollution Dragon smells and has a hard time making friends. This poor creature will eat just about anything and was cursed by a witch to be a living landfill after being caught one too many times raiding the trash and leaving behind a mess.

tid_unit_2072_description: Everything is butterflies and rainbows for the Colorful Dragon…literally. This graceful creature only has space for positive vibes and will light up any room. Any negativity around this dragon will result in a blast of happiness.

tid_unit_2091_description: Keeping the Topaz Dragon happy isn’t that difficult, just tell her she’s the prettiest of all her sisters. This dazzling beast may be a looker, but she’s never too pretty to unleash havoc and will always use her glimmering ways to justify it.

tid_temporarystring_unit_1362_descriptio: The Crowned Dragon is soccer royalty and one of the best players of Dragon City. This beloved dragon is admired and respected by all because he’d rather lose than leave another dragon behind. His love for teamwork is what makes him so great!

tid_unit_2109_description: The Honey Collector Dragon is imperative to the well being of all dragons and is an essential part of Dragon City’s ecosystem. Dragons go out of their way to protect him, but he can fend for himself. He may be small, but he packs a mean punch.

tid_temporary_unit_1788_description: The Challenge Dragon is very competitive, always wants to be number one, and takes everything too seriously. He will challenge any dragon: any time, any place. He doesn’t do it for fun either, he does it to win.

tid_unit_2099_description: The Redeemer Dragon used to turn red whenever he was angry and ready to go wild in battle. Now, this hot-headed beast makes baby dragons cry, is permanently red, and is always on the search for new enemies to destroy.

tid_unit_2163_description: The Boreas Dragon helps bring winter to Dragon City. He may be responsible for the cold, but dragons love him because he’s also responsible for the winter wonderland atmosphere on the islands, consisting of snow, pretty twinkly lights, and winter activities.

tid_unit_2144_description: The Furfur Dragon is from the thick, tropical rainforest and is at one with nature. This shy, bushy dragon prefers to seek her enemies out behind the comfort of green thickets and robust trees making her the queen of camouflage.

tid_unit_2186_description: The Decay Dragon is known for two things: His ominous energy and his toxic touch. Dragons keep their distance because it’s been said that everything he touches will immediately begin to decompose and waste away.

tid_unit_2192_description: There’s no greater fan of football than the Football Dragon. From historical touchdowns and fouls to running backs and quarterbacks, this dragon knows it all! He tried to join a team once, but he was terrible, so now he just dresses the part.

tid_unit_2195_description: The Space Pirate Dragon is a true bandit and is as evil as he looks. Legend has it, this ruthless creature is searching between galaxies and multiverses for his stolen treasure and once found, he will make the culprit walk the plank.

tid_unit_1716_skin1_description_locked: You can purchase the Beloved Unicorn Dragon Skin here. This Skin will be available in the St. Valentine offer!

tid_unit_1311_skin1_description_locked: You can purchase the Apocalypse Sun Dragon Skin here.

tid_unit_1020_skin2_description_locked: Get the Golden Flame Dragon Skin by leveling up to level 10.

tid_unit_1880_skin1_description_locked: Get the Bronze Kitsune Dragon Skin by leveling up to level 20.

tid_unit_1000_skin1_description_locked: Use the Nature Dragon in 30 breedings to get the Nature Crush Dragon Skin.

tid_unit_2230_description: The Dust Dragon’s body is made of the earth’s finest jewels and minerals, but that’s really of no importance to him. This lazy dragon just wants a solitary life of peace and quiet and will start an avalanche if he is disturbed.

tid_unit_1649_skin1_description_locked: Get the Friend Bunny Dragon Skin by collecting chocolate bunnies!

tid_unit_2251_description: The Happy Egg Dragon is every dragon’s cheerleader. This jolly dragon is a Dragon City favorite, always has a smile on his face, and only wants to spread happy vibes. He’s so merry, it’s hard to believe he’s twins with the Angry Egg Dragon.

tid_unit_2218_description: The Dark Commander Dragon was kicked off a mission by the High Commander Dragon and is now seeking revenge on him and any of his allies. Every bone in his body is evil and he’ll make enemies where there are none… all in the name of vengeance.

tid_unit_2269_description: Made from the most advanced technology in the Milky Way, the Mechano Dragon's robotic suit gives him extendable limbs with immense crushing power. For him, traveling through rough terrains is a piece of cake. Dragon and machine have become one!

tid_unit_2288_description: The Explorer Dragon fulfills her wanderlust by traveling the lands and sailing the seas! She is able to navigate through any terrain and is prepared to face all types of challenges as well as any dragons that interrupt her expeditions!

tid_unit_2390_description: A powerful yet misunderstood dragon, its purple energy can tear down mountains. The Raven Dragon has been Nyx's minion for as long as it can remember... But does it really want to fight on the side of evil or is it victim to Nyx's charm?

tid_unit_2377_description: A small but mighty powerhouse, the Agile Dragon can charge towards enemies at unimaginable speeds. Its protective exterior can withstand brute forces even though it is lightweight. They sometimes run alongside each other in packs.

tid_unit_2325_description: A villainous entity who feeds on the luminescence of light dragons. The Hollowtress Dragon converts their energy into dark matter, using it to build her underworld lair, a place where light dragons would be unlucky to wander into. However, the Stellartress Dragon isn't usually far behind.

tid_unit_2394_description: Designed and named by the Dragon City Community, the High Overlord Dragon is one menacing beast! He takes no prisoners when it comes to battling... His bones are ignited with blue flames that can scorch the battlefield in seconds, using his bow and arrow to target distant foes.

tid_unit_2338_description: A brave gladiator who lives for the applause of the crowd, the Colosseum Dragon likes to put on a show when he destroys his enemies. He's trained his whole life for the ultimate battle and nothing will stop him earning his victory.

tid_unit_2413_description: The McCreamy Dragon is a fan favorite on DragonTube! This skilled battler is known for his trickshotting abilities that can wipe out any opponent on the field. Watch out for this creamy foe!

tid_unit_2426_description: This dragon has serious F.O.M.O - Fear Of Missing Out! Always bringing the best beats and chill vibes, he'll never say no to a party, and you can bet he's always the last one standing... Life's too short to go home early!

tid_unit_2414_description: This dragon is the City's number one racer...or so he believes. Constantly running late, the Speed Racer Dragon is always trying to overtake other dragons, rather precariously! If you're prone to road rage, stay away from this one!

tid_unit_2462_description: The unbreakable member of the titan deities that once protected Dragon City, the Metal Titan Dragon has grown an exterior harder than diamond. Nothing can penetrate this beast, nor budge it from its iron stance.

tid_unit_2460_description: The Green Meadows Dragon is a large fellow, known for his lush foliage. Smaller dragons will sometimes start nesting on this huge beast's back, essentially living in a 'moving habitat'.  Perhaps we are all living on one of these giant dragons?

tid_unit_2471_skin1_description_locked: Get the Revival Armor Skin by completing 24 Laps in the Reborn Heroic Race!

tid_unit_2479_description: A dragon of the seas. The Neptune God Dragon is the brother of the Jupiter and Pluto God dragons. He rules over all freshwater and saltwater dragons, whether they know it or not!

tid_unit_2506_description: Said to have come from a lost world, it wasn't until one Dragon Master managed to tame this beast and accompany him back to his home. What lies on the other side of the portal? Roars of undiscovered Primal dragons...

tid_unit_2539_description: A fan favorite on DragonTube, the Preston Dragon has finally made his way to Dragon City! His tons of followers love his high-energy videos and crazy content!

tid_unit_2546_description: With tons of views of DragonTube, the Mully Dragon is one of our favorite VR gamers! He's always making his fans laugh especially when he's with his mates, the JoshDub and EddieVR dragons!

tid_unit_2553_description: The ancient High Earthen Dragon was undiscovered until one brave Dragon Master found it hibernating underground. Its serpent-like body allows it to swiftly move under the dirt and catch any unsuspecting prey from below.

tid_unit_2561_description: Son of the Isis Goddess Dragon and Osiris God Dragon, the Horus God Dragon is a symbol of war and the sky. After magically restoring his left eye, which was hurt in battle, this dragon also came to represent healing.

tid_unit_2636_description: Whether you're looking for power, skill, or just some laughs, the Muselk Dragon is the guy for the job! Mr. Muselk is waiting to be added to your collection!

tid_unit_2588_skin1_description_locked: Get the Interstellar Shielding Skin by completing 23 Laps in the Deep Space Heroic Race!

tid_unit_2624_description: The Aladdin Dragon didn't have a dime to his name, but after suddenly coming into a large sum of wealth, he now boasts garments of gold! And no, this dragon doesn't need an airborne piece of tapestry, he has wings... duh.

tid_unit_2627_description: A well-traveled dragon whose experiences inspire her to create enchanting songs and melodies. The Bard Dragon uses her spellbinding musical talents to immobilize enemies and aid allies in need.

tid_unit_2641_description: When the Very Rare Blue Dragon met with the Epic Yellow Dragon, it came as a complete surprise that a new Legendary dragon was created! But hey presto, the Green Dragon is ready to get down to business!

tid_unit_2650_description: You may not like her humanoid form, but don't be fooled, looks can be deceiving... Her innocent glances hide her expertise in martial arts, meaning she is clearly capable of committing the perfect crime. Her alibi? Kicking butt in the dojo!

tid_unit_2716_description: A dragon that once provided warmth to the Habitats of young dragons... The Corrupted Flame Dragon now scorches their homes for fun. It seems that there is no escaping these claws of corruption.

tid_unit_2656_description: The clear daredevil of the show, the Projectile Dragon will launch himself high into the sky causing the bystanders below to gasp with fear. Why gasp? Well, might we remind you that this adrenaline junkie is wingless!

tid_unit_2662_skin1_description_locked: Get the Armor of Time Skin by completing 23 Laps in the Time Travel Heroic Race!

tid_unit_2679_description: Before the industrial revolution of Dragon City, the High Queen Joadycea Dragon ruled the lands with grace. Representing her Pure House, she has left her throne to seek the ultimate battle sword. Other House leaders will fight to fill her place.

tid_unit_2689_description: New Generation Fae: Often painted as an evil Fae, the Fae-Fatal Dragon leads the resistance against the Fae Kingdom, so Faes of all backgrounds can have their share of Fairy Dust.

tid_unit_2831_description: All Ascended dragons are brave, so what makes the Ascended Bravery Dragon so special? As well as being unphased by physical harm, this dragon shows moral courage and is never afraid to stand up for what is right.

tid_unit_2702_description: By using its sharp teeth to pierce its prey before giving them a nasty electric shock, the Eelectrifying Dragon is certainly one terrifying creature that you don't want to meet underwater.

tid_unit_2726_description: The Arid Ambassador has traveled from the Desert Lands with the intention to forge an alliance with the Polar Regions. Historically, these two communities have not been the best of friends, but this diplomat hopes to change that!

tid_unit_2751_description: A returning mature student, the Potion Apprentice Dragon actually flunked his potion classes all those years ago. Now's he's returned to the Academy ready to advance his formulas and impress the Dean.

tid_unit_2757_skin1_description_locked: Get the Pressurized Gold Skin by completing 23 Laps in the Dwelling Danger Heroic Race!

tid_unit_2788_skin1_description: By simply owning this Skin, your dragon will deal boosted damage for his Leech Fang skill and Light attack! Please restart your game for this to take effect.

tid_unit_2836_description: By channeling his inner emotions, the Kung Flow Karma Dragon is able to deliver precise and devastating blows to his Corrupted enemies! This expert in martial arts never misses a target.

tid_unit_2800_description: Most species were wiped out when the frozen apocalypse hit, the Tundra Scout Dragon, however, began to thrive in this new environment. Its knowledge of the land means it can scout out all types of shelter and food!

tid_unit_2844_skin1_description: Enhance the High Reign Dragon's battle defenses!

tid_unit_2832_description: Redemption Ring: when they fall in battle, they heal their allies. The Redemption Blade Dragon has risen from the dead to make amends for the atrocities his group committed all those years ago. Is he capable of innocently wielding his blade?

tid_unit_2861_skin1_description_locked: Get the Honeycomb Shell Skin by completing 23 Laps in the High Colony Heroic Race!

tid_unit_2875_description: Dragon City’s 10th Birthday collectible: The Jewelem Dragon is a Tower Guardian who’s quite popular among the Dragon Masters… She owns plenty of the City’s most precious resource: Gems! A Gem a day keeps the stress at bay!

tid_unit_2880_description: Dragon City’s 10th Birthday collectible: The Speedy & Greedy Dragons are Tower Guardians, brother and sister to be exact, who like to help out Dragon Masters with particularly large Cities! They’ll cover all your Gold and Food collecting needs!

tid_unit_2882_description: Albeit a more modern warrior than the Cavemodo Dragon, the Musketeer Dragon still isn't fully accustomed to 21st-century living! She'd love for you to send her back to her time, while she waits, she'll happily beat anyone in a fencing match!

tid_unit_2913_description: He's crafty, crazy, and loves a good challenge! Add the Craftee Dragon to your team and watch him craft his way to success in battles!

tid_unit_2931_description: A Jack of all trades, the Clubs Dragon is the perfect all-rounder when it comes to meeting your team's needs. Whether he's hitting the nightclub or hitting his foes with a club, he'll make sure to deal you in on the fun!

tid_unit_2937_description: This insidious librarian doesn't just look after a bunch of dusty, old books... No, the Tentacularian Dragon enchants these ancient tales, meaning whoever reads them aloud becomes trapped inside, making these fictional horrors a reality.

tid_unit_2958_description: When galloping across the dreamlands, the Pixie Drake dragon will leave a trail of enchanted pixie magic in its wake. This magic can grant wishes to those with a pure heart; for others, it acts as a poisonous deterrent!

tid_unit_2982_description: A super addition to the Dhar Mann Fam! The Super Dhar Mann Dragon is here to create powerful messages that resonate with dragons and Dragon Masters alike!

tid_unit_3142_skin2_description: By simply owning this Skin, your dragon will deal boosted damage for its Legend & Terra attacks and get an extra turn on the battlefield! Please restart your game for this to take effect.

tid_unit_3011_skin3_description_locked: Get the All-Seeing Father Skill Skin by completing the Karma Calls collection from September 23rd - October 21st, 2024.

tid_unit_3145_skin1_description: By simply owning this Skin, your dragon will deal boosted damage and receive boosted life points for its Absorption skill, as well as deal boosted damage for its Pure attack.

tid_unit_2979_description: With sufficient water and light, the Cactus Dragon was able to grow her spines and take over the desert lands! The Cactispine Dragon can effortlessly puncture her enemies, she still loves cuddles from her Dragon Master, though...

tid_unit_2993_description: Eons ago, Forests of Life were full of magical trees, each forming a symbiotic relationship with its Tree of Life Dragon. Sadly, these forests no longer stand today, yet you can still see the odd Tree of Life or its dragon if you're lucky.

tid_unit_3081_description: The Ascended spend their time protecting the Realm while staying out of trouble. Yet, their leader, the High Ascended Supreme Dragon, is hatching a plan for them to descend on the sea of vampiric corruption below. Communication with his Eternal allies is the key...

tid_unit_3015_description: Originating solely from Mania Island, this small but vicious beast comes with delightfully demonic qualities... The Devil Dragon becomes active at night and makes very loud screeching noises, you'll think you've been transported to a hellish inferno!

tid_unit_3017_skin1_description: Protect the ancestral eggs with golden reinforcements.

tid_unit_3033_description: What is Chaos? One look into this dragon's eyes will have your question answered. The Chaos Dragon's existence was initially disputed until it was sighted attacking grazing dragons on farms. It apparently has bloodthirsty tendencies.

tid_unit_3049_description: The obvious favorite to be crowned this year's Summer Queen, the Beautiful Dragon has come too far for someone else to snatch her well-deserved flower crown! Being a creature of pure Beauty is hard work, but it won't stop her attempts to impress the Midsummer Dragon.

tid_unit_3062_description: In the Watermelee Dragon's tribe, all dragons have thick, impenetrable hides. Young Watermelee Dragons play at “combat training” by spitting high-powered seeds at each others' backs – a game that older dragons in the tribe think is pretty gross.

tid_unit_3158_skin1_description_locked: Get the Viper Skill Skin by completing the Plasma Colony collection from October 11th to November 8th, 2023.

tid_unit_3146_description: Quantum Quintet: Their accuracy is fatal. A ghost of the dragon it once used to be, the Quantum Ghost Dragon barely remembers its past life. Its deathly apparition will appear in front of Karma dragons before unleashing a fatal blow.

tid_unit_3085_description: Dynamic Duos unite! Master of the Sea element, the Duo-Delicate Dragon is considered one of the most beautiful creatures of the oceans. Her delicate scales can be sold for a high price.

tid_unit_3093_description: Dynamic Duos unite! Master of the Legend element, the Duo-Demand Dragon has got news of disputes between Houses. High Queen Joadycea is out and the Snow Monarch is in?! As leader of the Shadow Council, it's his job to sort this mess out!

tid_unit_3113_description: After volunteering to save her sister from the Dragon Royale, the Duo-Delusion Dragon has made it far enough to have a real chance of winning this thing! She's got a few tricks, or venomous snakes, up her sleeve to see off the final competition.

tid_unit_3120_description: Often sighted atop of Snowglobia's highest peak, the Halo Dragon will flutter her wings to cast a light dusting of powder snow over the town. She could prove to be Globalia's most useful ally during these dark times.

tid_unit_3148_skin1_description_locked: Get the Colony Skill Skin by completing the Plasma Purge collection.

tid_unit_3187_description: Guard Guild: they defend their allies until the bitter end! Instead of creating physical barriers, the Pulseguard Dragon holds back his enemies with waves of hypnotizing music. His trusty violin pulsates with a mesmerizing rhythm.

tid_unit_3175_description: A little dose of passion is sometimes all that's needed to bring dragons together! The High Passion Dragon is here to put an end to the Storyteller Dragon's twisted words and reunite Hanshock & Gretackle's warring descendants.

tid_unit_3442_skin1_description: By simply owning this Skin, your dragon will deal boosted damage and receive boosted life points.

tid_unit_3185_description: Found deep inside the jungle, the High Grotto Dragon protects its grotto at the core of the island – totally off-limits for tourists. Anyone who has ever entered its cavern of skulls has never been seen again.

tid_unit_3190_description: Producing some of the most valuable eggs in Dragon City, the Opulent Dragon must protect its nest from sweet-toothed thieves! Its jewel-encrusted chocolate treats can usually be found at the end of an egg hunt and can be sold for millions!

tid_unit_3196_skin1_description: A lightweight, aerodynamic body suit made from the riches of those taken by the sea.

tid_unit_3216_description: Celebrate 12 whole years of Dragon City with the Birthday Dragon! Close your eyes, blow out the candle, make a wish, and he'll do his best to make it come true! Just don't insult his tomato frosting...he worked really hard on it.

tid_unit_3258_skin1_description: By simply owning this Skin, your dragon and her allies will receive boosted life points for her Silky Slumber skill, deal boosted damage for her Nature attack, and her overall damage stat and life points will be boosted by 25%. Please restart your game for this to take effect.

tid_unit_3273_skin2_description_locked: Get the Aqua Skill Skin in the Elite Divine Pass during the Strategic Minds Season.

tid_unit_3272_skin1_description: By simply owning this Skin, your dragon's overall life points will be boosted by 25%, it will deal boosted damage for its Evasion skill & Ice attack, and have a reduced skill cooldown of only 3 turns.

tid_unit_3272_skin2_description_locked: Get the Lotus Skill Skin in the Elite Divine Pass during the Elusive Illusion Season.

tid_unit_3338_skin1_description: By simply owning this Skin, your dragon's overall damage stat and life points will be boosted by 25%.

tid_unit_3328_description: The Legion Lieutenant Dragon led the Shadow Council's physical takeover of the lands. After the Snow Monarch's government fell, the Lieutenant and the Duo-Disarm Dragon enforced the strict laws with severe punishment.

tid_unit_3343_description: Venture into the complex maze of the Lucky Woodland and be blessed with the luck of the Lucky Charm Dragon! Carry him around wherever you go to ward off any misfortune...

tid_unit_3370_description: You can always count on the friendly Pride Warrior Dragon to be by your side marching for equality and creating a safe space for all. They've got your back and you've got theirs – let's keep making a difference!

tid_unit_3383_description: Often seen gliding over Blissful Beach, the Gliding Gull Dragon is on the lookout for any tasty snacks below, so keep your picnic close, otherwise it'll be gone in a flash!

tid_unit_3401_skin1_description: By simply owning this Skin, your dragon's overall damage stat and life points will be boosted by 25%.

tid_unit_3430_skin1_description: By simply owning this Skin, your dragon's overall damage stat and life points will be boosted by 25% and he will receive the Expert Evasion skill.

tid_unit_3424_description: The drum sounds, the Priestess enters, and the Doom Dancer Dragon begins his dance. The bones around his neck rattle and clack, reminding you of your fate as a soon-to-be Marked One. Don't worry, he'll collect what remains...

tid_unit_3411_description: Lying, deception, and cheating... The Lifetime Liar Dragon will ensure you are the top Dragon Master, and ruler of the Kingdom, by spreading white lies in your favor. Yet, if you choose the path of honesty, he'll make a formidable enemy.

tid_unit_3458_description: A roaming titan of rock and stardust, this dragon transforms the battlefield into a literal crash site with every strike. Are you prepared to command the sheer kinetic fury of a planetary impact, or will you just be left in the dust?

tid_unit_3451_description: The High Risen Nature Dragon has transcended the forests of its youth to command the canopy itself, where sunlight filters through leaves and life grows wild. It carries the essence of blooming meadows and ancient groves, nurturing saplings with gentle care. Yet those who seek to harm its domain will face the full fury of nature's wrath, where thorns grow sharper and roots strike like serpents.

tid_unit_3237_sakura_flair_description: Dress up Spiked Leatherback Dragon for the Sakura season with this exclusive Flair!

tid_unit_2932_sakura_flair_description: Dress up High Treasure Dragon for the Sakura season with this exclusive Flair!

tid_unit_2905_sakura_flair_description: Dress up Fragmented Karma Dragon for the Sakura season with this exclusive Flair!

tid_unit_3463_description: The legend needed a glow-up, and boy did it deliver. The High-Risen Poo Dragon took everything that made the original iconic and turned it up to eleven. Bigger, angrier, smellier and now it has a plunger. The king is back.

tid_unit_3461_skin1_description: By simply owning this Skin, your dragon's Astro Overdrive will damage all enemy team.

tid_unit_3476_skin2_description: By simply owning this Flair, your dragon's overall damage stat and life points will be boosted by 5%

tid_unit_3357_anniversary_14_flair_descr: Dress up High Thirteen Dragon for the 14th Anniversary with this exclusive Flair!

tid_unit_3426_anniversary_14_flair_descr: Dress up Doom Forger Dragon for the 14th Anniversary with this exclusive Flair!

tid_unit_3464_description: Mastery over the elements is within reach of very few, and when the Dragon Stormaiden uses her magical scepter, storms and thunder obey her commands. She dwells in the frozen lands that she herself blankets in ice, where she can unleash her fury in the form of a tempest

tid_unit_3473_skin1_description: By simply owning this Skin, your dragon's Guard Skill will absorb more damage.

tid_pets_offer_avoid_reset_header: Don't let your pet go hungry, you still have time to level up!

tid_new_FBconnect_desc: We would like to ask you a few questions to better understand the social media you use and why. Thanks for your help!

tid_new_steamshop_event_header: 72 DRAGONS IN TOTAL WILL HAVE GREAT DISCOUNTS!

tid_news_premiumcashback_desc: Now is the time to buy! Purchase a Premium Island (Marvel, Wonder, or Mystic) and receive plenty of Gems as a bonus Reward!

tid_news_deepspacecollection_desc: Collect enough Dark Matter to fuel your space flight and earn some interstellar Rewards, including the exclusive Quasar Dragon, Empowered to 2 Stars!

tid_news_murdermysterycollection_desc: Tons of Clues, 5 mysterious suspects, and 3 items in question...\nOpen Clue Chests and Suspects Chest to bring you one step closer to catching the culprit!

tid_news_clashofhouses_desc: Open Banner Chests to collect Sword Fragments and find the Banners of each House! Can you forge the Ultimate Battle Sword?

tid_news_DMbreedingperks_desc: Attach Breeding Perks to your dragons via the feeding screen to improve the chances of breeding better offspring! Get these Perks by completing new tasks in Dragon Mastery.

tid_news_moonguardians_desc: Meet the High Moon Empress and her 2 Moon Guardians! Are you brave enough to explore the dark side of the moon?

tid_news_dragonmysteries2_part3_desc: Can you believe it?! It seems the Deputy Dragon had this whole thing planned! She kidnapped the Prince so she could become Ruler! Did you work it out, Dragon Masters?

tid_news_darkestmirror_header: Find the Broken Mirrors to collect different types of Shards and restore the reflections of your beloved dragons! Don't look for too long, your reflection may be standing behind you...

tid_news_friendshipday_desc: Celebrate International Friendship Day by collecting Friendship Hearts found in Quests and the Calendar to get some exclusive Rewards!

tid_news_theboys_desc: Here come The Boys! Find their dragon in the Breeding Island, in Offers, or in the Hidden Volcano Maze Island!

tid_news_beastgamer_desc: He's back! Catch the new Beast Gamer Dragon in the Dreams of Chaos Maze Island, in Offers, or in the Breeding Island where you'll also find the other Mr. Beast dragons!

tid_news_prestonflash_desc: The Preston Flash Dragon is here! Find him in the Breeding Island, in Offers, or in the Terror Tunnel Maze Island!

tid_news_speedupHH_3hrs_header: Tired of waiting for your Breedings, Hatchings, and Constructions to finish? During this time, you can simply watch a video ad to skip the final 3 hours!

tid_news_saveprogress_desc_btm: Connect to a platform and get:

tid_news_frostpocalypse_desc: Venture through this frozen wasteland and survive the Frostpocalypse! Grab your coat, it's cold out there...

tid_news_savingxmascollection_header: Stuff your face with Festive Food, light up your tree with Xmas Lights, and exchange Holiday Gifts! Find all these items throughout Dragon City to complete your collection!

tid_news_icecoronationcollection_header: Find and collect the three celebration gifts throughout the Islands and crown the new Snow Monarch! Oh, and don't forget about the Antidote...

tid_news_bloodeclipse_desc: Meet the winner of the Design a Dragon Contest: the High Bloody Moon Dragon! Join him during the Blood Eclipse in his search for the Bloody Moon fortune!

tid_news_primalbeauty_desc: Their parents may disapprove, but Graceful and Primalio will do whatever it takes to be together... Help reunite the Beauty and the Primal!

tid_news_july4th24_desc: Tune into Dragon TV to collect July 4th Fireworks and obtain the High Overlord Dragon, plus plenty more Rewards!

tid_news_thrillingisland_header: All of your Islands already full?\nExpand to the new Thrilling Island – the perfect place for all thrill-seeker dragons!

tid_news_NLP22_2_header: AMC's The Walking Dead is here...\nFind 6 iconic characters from the hit TV show with the new Bunker skill! You can currently find Negan, Michonne & Maggie and remember, this will be your only chance to obtain these dragons!

tid_news_miniVAautumn23_desc: Tune in to Dragon TV to get your hands on some ancient antique bargains! Collect these rare statues and trade them in for some huge Rewards!

tid_news_kimby_desc: This is your chance to meet the exclusive Kimby Dragon! Find her in the Evo-Run Island! Think you can catch her?

tid_news_festivefrenzy_header: Give yourself a gift this festive season with some HUGE Offers!\nFind tons of exclusive and VIP dragons in the Shop for a limited time only!

tid_news_as_masterofmasters4_desc: The new Master of Master Arenas are underway! Face other Dragon Masters to get the exclusive Stellartress Dragon and Habitat Tokens!

tid_news_wizardshollow_teaser3_header: \nVenturing deep into the Wizards' Hollow could reward you greatly, but there'll be a price to pay when trespassing on the land of these crooked spirits. How far will you reach?

tid_news_newarenas_mar23_header: Battle it out with your most timeless dragons and use the power of Time to claim Warrior's Chests, which guarantee you exclusive dragons if all are claimed within the Arena season!

tid_news_rebornretold_actualcollection_h: Ring the Magic Bells found in the Event Islands & Quests and transform your Banana, Penguin, and Ice Cube Dragons into evolved beasts!

tid_news_11thbirthday_desc: Collect Birthday Gifts and Hampers found in the upcoming Event Islands & Dragon TV to earn yourself huge rewards, including exclusive birthday decorations!

tid_news_heroicRedemption_skins_header: High Redemption Norn Dragon: Risen & Fallen Skill Skins! By simply owning these Skins, she will deal boosted damage, with the Fallen Skill Skin also reducing self-damage and her skill cooldown by 1! Please restart your game for this to take effect.

tid_news_arenasupdate3_teaser_header: Keep an eye out for some exciting updates coming to the Arenas...\nThere'll be new Rewards up for grabs that you won't want to miss!

tid_news_newarenas_jul23_header: Battle it out with your most renowned dragons and use the power of Legend to claim Warrior's Chests, which guarantee you exclusive dragons if all are claimed within the Arena season!

tid_news_as_masterofmasters_electric_des: The new Master of Master Arenas are underway! Face other Dragon Masters to get the exclusive Triumphant Dragon and Habitat Tokens!

tid_news_websitedivinepass_header: Hit the button below to claim your free daily Insignia and find more information about this Season's Divine Pass. There are plenty more treats waiting for you!

tid_news_azurecolddragon_desc: Collect Azure Snowflakes to obtain the new Azure Cold Dragon! Find them in the next three Maze Islands during the Below Freezing: Part 2, Valentine's Vault, and Shadow Council: Part 1 events!

tid_news_fallenguild_desc: Rearrange 'A-R-C-A-N-E' and what do you get? The High Nacrea Dragon! Find the High Arcane Dragon's pearly replacement in a new Heroic Race.

tid_news_BF23_offers_desc: Find the most powerful Heroic dragons in exclusive Black Friday Offers for a limited time only! There are Occult Badges thrown in too!

tid_news_newarenas_war_desc: Battle it out with your War Dragons and use their power to obtain exclusive Rewards, including the Guardian Angel Dragon!

tid_news_unleashthespeed_header: Baby dragons are curious creatures, always wanting to explore... They've uncovered an ancient Boot belonging to the long-lost Bolt Dragon, unleashing Speed across the Dragonverse!

tid_news_happynewsphere_desc: Collect Sparkle Jars & Wish Spheres from the Event Islands, Quests & Dragon TV to help the High Aurasphere Dragon bring Snowglobia into 2024!

tid_news_lunarnewyear24_desc: Celebrate the Year of the Dragon and earn huge Rewards by collecting Dragon Temples from the Mystery in Paradise Event Islands and our website!

tid_news_mythicalmarathon_robird_desc: Race other Dragon Masters in a Mythical Race to obtain the Robird Dragon and earn tons of Rewards, including Orbs to Empower it!

tid_news_mysteryinparadise_desc: Paradise Island is dying, but why? Help the Inspector find evidence by collecting Lotus Flowers, Gecko Tails & Larimar. Remember to recheck item & dragon descriptions for clue updates!

tid_news_maraudermonsoon_desc: Prepare for April Showers by collecting enough Ship Timber & Pirate Flags to build your own ark! Found them in Dry Boxes placed in the Event Islands, Quests & Dragon TV.

tid_news_savethebeasts_desc: Find Wooden Garden Planters in the Event Islands, Quests & Dragon TV to collect Sweet Nectar & Bee Smokers for another great day of saving the beasts! Plus, find unowned dragons in the Maze Island!

tid_news_heroicBerserker_teaser_header: The first Heroic Berserker dragon is approaching! It welcomes you to its underwater Kingdom—but be careful, naive Dragon Masters often get caught up in its 'feeding frenzy'...

tid_news_quickskiptimer50_header: Reduce your breeding, hatching, Summoning, Empowering, and Recalling times by 50% with the Quick Skip Timer! This remains active from June 27th to July 4th, 2024. Please restart your game for this to take effect.

tid_news_academyscurse_potionmaestro_des: The apprentice has become the master! The Potion Maestro Dragon's elixirs are said to cure venomous dragon bites... Find them in the Event Islands, Quests & Dragon TV!

tid_news_gemchallenge_header: Every Gem counts! Spend Gems anywhere in Dragon City to reach milestones and earn juicy Rewards! The more you spend, the more you get!

tid_news_allhallowseve_desc: Explore the misty forest and look under Toadstools to follow the trail of Will-o'-wisps and Pebbles if you want to escape the October fog!

tid_news_heroicSpiked_questteaser_header: Battle against the exclusive High Spiked Rhinodillo Dragon in a new Quest to test your skills!

tid_news_blackvoid_s2_header: Get boosted damage for its Void Compression skill with the Black Skill Skin found in the Black Friday collection! Please restart your game for this to take effect.

tid_news_adventsecrets_s2_header: Join the Kringle Kingdom Dragon as she goes from door to door asking Dragon City residents to help decorate the trees in time for Mr. Kringle's arrival! You might even learn some secrets along the way...

tid_news_adventsecrets_quest_header_6: Behind the sixth Advent Door answers a bony fiend with a guilty pleasure of the festivities! Grave Lurker will dig up some haunted decorations for you if put in a good word about him to Mr. Kringle.\nNext stop, the head of the Kringle Army!

tid_news_chaospass_header: Complete missions to earn points and reach milestones full of Rewards, including a new Skill Skin for your Corrupted Chaos Dragon!

tid_news_arenapass_header_s2_v3: Get the following Arena Season's chosen Tributes in this Pass! All previous Rewards found in the Arena Showdown collection can now be obtained in the Free Path of the Pass.

tid_news_conservationdaypass_s2_header: Purchase the Golden Tier, complete all missions to reach the Conservation Day Monument, and be rewarded with your own personalized certificate from Dots.eco! You can find this certificate in EVENTS in Settings.

tid_news_winstancesrevenge_header: Oh-no! Winstance has been taken under the evil wings of the Vampire family... And he's returned to take revenge on all those who have wronged him!

tid_news_easterDTV25_desc: Tune into Dragon TV each day to collect Easter DTV Eggs and earn yourself the iconic Egg Hunter Dragon as well as Orbs to Empower him!

tid_news_heroicEvader_BP_header: Grab the new Divine Pass to obtain the first-ever Heroic Evader dragon... The High Elusion Evader Dragon!\nWhy not go Elite to get 300 of its Orbs, plus a special Lotus Skill Skin that boosts damage dealt.

tid_news_valentinestory_2_header: You decided to buy him a luxury box of chocolates... Unfortunately, the Sour Dragon prefers sour candy. Redeem this code: CHOCOLATE on our Website to claim a consolation prize.

tid_news_silenceseekers_muzzled_s2_heade: Use Muzzled Bluff to deal damage with a chance to silence opponents for 2 turns.\nIncrease the chance of Silence being applied by leveling up your dragon!

tid_news_wickedsilencer_header: Use Beauty Sleep to deal damage and silence opponents for 2 turns.

tid_news_carnival25_desc: Collect Carnival Parrots from Event Islands, Quests, Offers, and various in-game Passes to earn tons of Rewards, including the High Gammaguard Dragon's new Carnival Skill Skin! Plus, find a new collection in your Dragonbook!

tid_news_highjustice_header: Get the Justice Skill Skin for your High Justice Dragon in the Race Pass to boost its overall damage stat and life points by 20%!

tid_news_purusstrategist_skins_s2_header: Get the Aqua Skill Skin in the Elite Divine Pass! Deal boosted damage while removing self-damage for his Soul Crusher+ Skill and receive boosted life points when using his Strategic Stems+ Skill.

tid_news_mayanpantheon_desc: Appease the Mayan Gods to allow your farms to flourish and dragons to grow strong! Open Mayan Chests found in the Event Islands & Quests to collect Mayan Totems & Masks.

tid_news_newskill_critical_desc: Skills with Critical Hit come with a chance to deal extra damage!

tid_news_heroicEvader2_teaser_header: The second Heroic Evader dragon is coming to cause some chaos... Ready for the anarchy? Play a new Quest to battle against High Anarchaos Evader and find some Evader Insignias for your Anarchist Collection along the way.

tid_news_fiestademayo_desc: Kick off your Cinco de Mayo celebrations by collecting Punch & Party Poppers found in the Event Islands, Quests, and Dragon TV!  Beware, a purple presence of evil lurks in the shadows...

tid_news_highcloakedcritical_skins_heade: Get the Mana Skill Skin by completing the Critical Cloak collection! Deal boosted damage for his Primal attack and boost his overall life points by 25%.

tid_news_norsegods_desc: Open Viking Chests to find a Baldr Staff or a Hel Rune and collect enough to earn awesome Rewards on your way to Asgard!

tid_news_sellingpoints_conductingcritica: Use Critical Conjuring to deal damage with a 50% chance of a Critical Hit.

tid_news_tropicaltides_desc: Visit the Tropical Tides and play this Grid Island to obtain the new Dune Dragon!

tid_news_highcivilarmored_skins_header_s: Get the Rebellion Skill Skin by completing your Sticker Album! It boosts your dragon's overall damage stat and life points by 25%.

tid_news_family_faceoff_quest_2: The Crit Crew is here to put your skills to the test in the second Family Face-off! Defeat High Cloaked Critical and other special guests in this Quest to earn cool rewards including Sticker Packs, Grid Coins, and Joker Orbs!

tid_news_severedsouls_header_s1: Collect Severed Antlers from the Maze Island, Arena Pass, and Quests to earn tons of Rewards, including a new Skill Skin for your High Severed Extractor Dragon!

tid_news_highflightarmored_skins_s1: Get the Plated Skill Skin in your Sticker Album! It boosts your dragon's overall damage stat and life points by 25%.

tid_news_academytournament_desc: Fly high in the Academy Tournament and play a new Grid Island to obtain the new Aerial Ace Dragon!

tid_news_shimmerarmored_s5: Get her Skill Skin in a new Quest for your dragon to receive 25% boosted life points and deal 25% boosted damage!

tid_news_herald_header_s3: Blinding Light: Deal damage to all opponents!

tid_news_trickortreat_web_header: Open Trick or Treat Chests and try your luck this Halloween! Find them in the login calendar or head to our Webstore to get tons of 'treats' and Rewards!

tid_news_chineseDTV26_desc: Tune into Dragon TV to obtain the Fire horse chest and Orbs of Pyrotechnic & Silent Slay Dragons

tid_news_highdoompriestess_s4: Use her active Doommark skill to apply 2 Doommarks to your enemies while also dealing damage!

tid_news_doomdancer_s2: Use his passive Doommark skill to apply a Doommark to an enemy upon joining battle!

tid_news_highdoombaron_s4: Use his Reincarnation skill to revive or heal your allies after a knock out, ensuring they are ready for the final attack!

tid_news_frozenfortune_lastchance_header: Only two days left before the Frozen Fortune is found! Collect as many Tundra Tickets as possible. Winners will be announced at the beginning of the year – check back then to see if you're a winner!

tid_news_hightorchskull_header_s3: Use Pyro Tornado to deal more damage when his health is low!

tid_news_newbeginnings2_desc: Open Hanshock Chests found in the Event Islands, Arena Pass, Quests & Dragon TV to find his Bells & Whips and collect enough to power up your Hanshock Dragon!

tid_news_ghost_of_the_past_s2: Use Divine Intervention to deal any remaining damage to another opponent.

tid_news_valentinesglobalchallenge2026_h: Team up with Dragon Masters around the world in the Valentine’s Global Challenge! Contribute points to reach the goal and unlock an exclusive Avatar and Monument for all!

tid_news_legendspass_desc: Battle in the  Arenas to collect Legends Points. Reach the required Milestone in the Legends Pass Track to unlock the Trophy Boost Deco and supercharge your Trophy gains!

tid_news_blossombreeding_desc: Breed dragons and collect enough Cherry Blossom Hearts to earn some big Rewards. Find them in the Hatch Pass, Fog & Maze Islands, Quests, and Dragon TV!

tid_news_astrosupernova_skins_s1: Get the Nova Flare Skill Skin in the Elite Divine Pass! Your dragon's Overdrive damage skill will deal extra damage and recover faster.

tid_news_mds_event_desc: Go to our website to claim new gifts and find exclusive deals just for you!

tid_news_astrogammaray_s3: A multi-hit orbital strike that ravages the entire enemy team while restoring your health. Total domination!

tid_news_superbowl_ads_25_desc: Tune into Dragon TV to obtain the Gridiron chest and Orbs of Guardian Angel Dragon

tid_news_apocalypsepath_prophet_web_head: Get the new False Prophet Dragon, part of the web-exclusive Apocalypse family! Collect VIP Dimes from Webstore Offers to reach milestones full of Rewards in the Apocalypse Path!

tid_news_petsdaypass_s3_header: Purchase the Platinum Tier and complete all missions to reach Mercury The Strategist Dragon! This comes with all the benefits of the Golden Tier, including your personalized certificate from Dots.eco.

tid_news_astrograviton_s3: Astro Life Steal. Steals life points from the opponent.

tid_news_apocalypsepath_famine_web_heade: Remember to visit the Dragon City Webstore to keep collecting VIP Dimes from Offers & Packs! Reach milestones full of Rewards in the Apocalypse Path, such as the new Famine Dragon!

tid_news_beeprotectionpass_header: Make real-world impact with the new Bee Protection Pass and help protect Bees through Dots.eco!

tid_news_glidingwhisper_s4_header: Get the Twilight Sovereign Skill Skin from the Platinum Lane of the Gliding Whisper Pass. This skin upgrades the Tempest Whisper skill and boosts your damage stat.

tid_news_apexofdawn_reveal1_header: A dragon of unimaginable power has arrived, and it's unlike anything in Dragon City. Its true form is still hidden, but even the first whispers of its abilities hint at something extraordinary. Collect Dawn Sigils and begin your ascent!

tid_news_apocalypsepath_death_web_header: Last chance to claim the new High Death Dragon in the Apocalypse Path! Get this rare dragon, a member of the VIP Apocalypse family, by collecting VIP Dimes.

tid_news_apexofdawn_reveal2_header_s2: Even its defeat is a weapon. Doommark, Apex of Dawn's second skill, brands every enemy when knocked out. This is what the apex of Dragon City looks like. Two more skills to come. Stay close.

tid_news_voidaetherstone_skins_s2: Get the Crimson Nocturne Skill Skin in your Sticker Album! Your dragon's overall damage stat and life points will be boosted by 25%!

tid_news_voidcustodian_s1: The gates of the unknown are officially open! Command the Void Custodian to drag your foes into the lightless deep, ensuring that those who enter the shadows never return.

tid_news_voidnightfeather_skins_s1: Get the Blazing Jester Skill Skin in a Quest! Your dragon's Drain attack will deal spill damage and its effects last longer.

tid_news_death_header_s4: Get the Sovereign Death Skin and your Shield of Erebus skill will drastically reduce the damage taken by the user and allies for several turns!

tid_news_voidfortress_s2: Drain. A neutralizing strike that strips the elemental essence from your rivals, leaving them powerless and exhausted.

tid_news_GrooveFest_desc: Navigate this Groove Fest Grid and reach the Wonderland in time to enjoy the ultimate music fest adventure!

tid_news_void_teaser_desc_2: The Second Heroic Void dragon is going to drain you dry... Play a new Quest to battle against the High Void Abyss Dragon!

tid_news_flightofthenorth_desc: Collect Rune Axes and Jarl's Hammers from Event Islands, Quests & Dragon TV!

tid_new_permanent_quests_header: CHECK OUT THE NEW EMPOWERED QUESTS
